name: DATRAS trawl surveys
description: Survey lists, exchange data (haul, length and age records), CPUE, indices and litter data from the ICES Database of Trawl Surveys (DATRAS).

notes.observation: `getHLdataSp` and `getCAdataSp` return an empty result for every species tried (AphiaIDs 126417, 126436, 126437), including species in the unfiltered `getHLdata` result for the same survey, year and quarter.

Responses are XML in the namespace `ices.dk.local/DATRAS` (`https://ices.dk.local/DATRAS` in some versions). Values are text, and missing values are empty elements. A survey, year and quarter with no data gives an empty list with HTTP 200.
notes.affects: icesDatras parses the XML itself, and handles both namespaces.

notes.observation: Exchange data and CPUE are returned for a whole survey, year and quarter: `getCPUELength` is 20 to 90 MB, and `getHLdata` up to tens of MB.
notes.affects: Downloads can be slow; the download API used by `getDatrasUnaggregated()` returns a zipped CSV instead.

notes.observation: Most data come from the ASMX web service (documented by its WSDL). `getDatrasUnaggregated()` uses the separate download API `Data_products/Download/DATRASDownloadAPI.aspx`, which returns a zip file with a CSV, and has no documentation.
The WSDL also lists upload operations (`UploadAndValidateFile`, `SaveDocument`, `ScreenResult`), which are not called by this check.
